description: This file contains functions for translating HTML content within markdown documents, including parsing, identifying HTML blocks, and translating text nodes while respecting HTML tags that should be skipped.

classes.name: htmlReplacement
classes.description: Struct representing a range in the HTML content to be replaced with translated text.

methods.name: translateHTMLBlocks
methods.description: Main function to translate HTML blocks within markdown content, replacing original HTML with translated versions.

methods.name: htmlBlockSpan
methods.description: Determines the start and stop positions of an HTML block within the source.

methods.name: applyHTMLReplacements
methods.description: Applies a list of replacements to the original HTML body, returning the updated string.

methods.name: sortHTMLReplacements
methods.description: Sorts the replacements list based on start positions.

methods.name: translateHTMLBlock
methods.description: Translates the textual content within an HTML fragment, skipping certain tags.

methods.name: shouldTranslateHTMLText
methods.description: Determines if a text node should be translated based on its content and context.

methods.name: isSkipTag
methods.description: Checks if an HTML tag should be skipped during translation (e.g., code, pre, script, style).
